description: Find douars, the villages and hamlets of Morocco's rural communes as HCP's 2024 census lists them, by name, in Arabic or in Latin letters: تشديرت and Tachdirt both find the douar of Asni. HCP names douars in Arabic only; the Latin name comes from a source where one writes it, and is otherwise spelt from the Arabic, which spelt marks. Returns each douar's code, its 2024 population and its commune; pass the commune's slug to get_douars for the douar's households and distances.

limit.description: How many results. 10 when left out, at most 50.

query.description: The douar's name, in Arabic or Latin letters.

name: search_douars

spelt.description: True when the Latin name is spelt from the Arabic rather than taken from a source.

title: Search Moroccan douars
